notes: Lead checked: Greater Toronto Sports Card Show. Only an Eventbrite listing (never fetch site) and an organizer name (POP UP Entertainment, inferred) turned up, with no organizer website and no 2026 or 2027 date, so it is in leads_only. Recorded two past Ontario editions whose pages write the year and give a table count: London Collectable Expo (Mar 1 2026, over 90 tables) and the Doug Laurie Sports show in Barrie (Jul 21 and 22 2023, over 40 tables). The London record uses CAD from the region brief because the page shows $ without a currency name. The Barrie page gives conflicting Friday hours (11 to 6 vs 11 to 5), so only the Friday date is recorded. No upcoming Ontario card show with a written date was confirmed. The Nov 1 London Pokemon and TCG show (todocanada 403) and the Nov 22 Hamilton CARDEX (probably 2025) are unverified. Searches covered Toronto area, London, Hamilton, Ottawa, Barrie, Stouffville, Windsor, Kitchener, Oshawa and Niagara. Kitchener, Windsor, Oshawa and Niagara returned only past or non Ontario items, and no 2027 Ontario card show was found. Skipped as out of scope or covered elsewhere: Sport Card Expo Toronto in Mississauga (Nov 5 to 8 2026, excluded by brief), an R&B Sports show in Ottawa, Kansas (US), and The Vault Card Show in Vancouver, BC. The Toronto Comic Book Show and the Greater Toronto Video Game Show at Montecassino are not card shows. The Pregrade guide's undated Toronto area, Ottawa and Hamilton regional entries were not recorded. Three 404 pages: tourismbarrie, tourismoxford, auctionsontario. Budget: 6 of 6 searches used; 12 fetches used (3 of them 403 or 404 on listing sites, counted above).
